channel.title: Shevris — Engineering notes
channel.description: A running log of releases, fixes, and infrastructure changes across Shevris products.

item.title: Credibility surfaces shipped
item.description: Brand & press kit with logo downloads, a security page with responsible-disclosure policy, an RSS feed for these notes, and per-entry permalinks.

item.title: Repositioned as a product company
item.description: Shevris is product-only: the services section is gone, and every call to action now points at Tijarah and the waitlist. We build our own subscription software — not apps on request.

item.title: Touch reaches parity with the cursor
item.description: The constellation now treats a finger exactly like a mouse — same 90px repel radius, same link distance. Push a strayed fragment with your thumb and it merges into a neighbouring web by proximity.

item.title: Zero blank frames on cold mobile loads
item.description: Section reveals now render fully visible in server HTML and only hide below the fold after their observer attaches — the documented-safe pattern for scroll animations. First paint no longer depends on hydration.

item.title: Scroll jank eliminated on touch devices
item.description: Blur reveals snap instantly on coarse pointers, the constellation caps at 30fps with delta-time scaling, and ambient orbs moved from blur filters to radial gradients — removing the three largest per-frame raster costs we could measure.

item.title: Interactive constellation shipped
item.description: A canvas particle field with pointer repel, magnetic CTAs, 3D card tilt, and ambient gradient orbs — all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion, all off the compositor-critical path.

item.title: shevris.com is live
item.description: Cutline identity on a Next.js static export, deployed to GitHub Pages through a development → main Git Flow with semantic PR gates, lint/typecheck/test CI, and Dependabot on a release-age cooldown.

item.title: Blue/green deploys for tijarah-api
item.description: Production and dev environments now deploy behind nginx upstream flips with health-gated rollback — no shared-state outages between releases.

item.title: OIDC deployments, no stored credentials
item.description: GitHub Actions authenticates to AWS via short-lived OIDC tokens. Long-lived access keys removed from the pipeline entirely.

item.title: Waitlist live at tijarah.pk
item.description: Independent GitHub Pages site accepting early signups ahead of the marketplace launch.
